// diagnostic

E0755

A function-typed field's row declares an effect the type's `#FX(…)` cap denies or its ceiling leaves out

What

A function-typed field's row declares an effect the type's `#FX(…)` cap denies or its ceiling leaves out

Why

A method that calls the field runs its row, and `#FX(…)` above a type bounds every method of the type through every path it runs

Fix

Narrow the field's row to fit the cap, move the field out of the type, or widen the type's `#FX(…)` cap

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0755: tests/ui/effects/type_field_row_outside_cap_is_e0755.stderr.

Error [jet.TypeFieldCapExceeded]: Field `act`'s row declares `IO`, which type `Holder` doesn't allow
  --> tests/ui/effects/type_field_row_outside_cap_is_e0755.jet:3:5
    |
  3 |     act: fn() -[IO]> Unit
    |     ^^^
  --> tests/ui/effects/type_field_row_outside_cap_is_e0755.jet:1:1
    |
  1 | #FX(!IO)
    | ^^^^^^^^ type `Holder` is capped here
 Why: A method that calls `act` runs its row, and the type's `#FX(…)` cap bounds every method of the type
 Fix: Narrow `act`'s row to fit the cap, move `act` out of type `Holder`, or widen the type's `#FX(…)` cap
 Denial: invocation
 Call chain: act
 Scope chain: type Holder
